summary_en: Yappli authorized acquisition of up to 383,000 shares (approximately 3.0% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 300 million yen between November 13, 2026 and January 31, 2027, citing flexible capital allocation and sustainable shareholder returns aligned with profit growth.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Yappli's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 383,000 treasury shares, representing approximately 3.0% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026, when 12,782,501 shares were outstanding), for a maximum total consideration of 300 million yen. The acquisition period runs from November 13, 2026 through January 31, 2027.

The company cited comprehensive consideration of current share price levels and financial position as the basis for the decision. Management stated the acquisition aims to enable flexible capital policy execution while maintaining stable and sustainable shareholder returns aligned with profit growth going forward. No specific acquisition price per share was disclosed in the announcement.
